selection: Only the validation split is eligible. The exploratory pilot chooses method details here; test is reserved for one frozen-method run. Within each stratum, clusters are visited round-robin after a seeded within-cluster shuffle so large models cannot exhaust the quota. If a stratum has fewer eligible validation reactions than its quota, every eligible reaction is taken and the shortfall is recorded; test/train are never used as a backfill. The cluster split is not rewritten to reach the nominal 200.

nonempty_answer_absent.action: included every eligible validation reaction; did not borrow from test/train

retrievable_rerank_failure.action: included every eligible validation reaction; did not borrow from test/train
